title: Novacliss / Lexxir Researcher Profile
summary: Corrupted personnel record concerning Novacliss, a researcher within the Lexxir division directed by Hephaestus Rigel.
body:
SUBJECT

NOVACLISS

ARCHIVE COPY STATUS: CORRUPTED

Novacliss is identified in surviving Lexxir documentation as a researcher working within the division directed by Hephaestus Rigel.

The surviving material indicates that Novacliss was a subordinate researcher rather than the head of an independent organisation or commercial entity.

The exact research assignment is not recoverable from the surviving copy. References connect the researcher to Lexxir's legacy artificial-life work and to the division responsible for Zephyr's model line.

Several personnel and project fields are missing or corrupted.

ARCHIVE NOTE

Do not use this copy to infer Novacliss's present position, authority or independent affiliation.
